name: blackhole-video
description: Launch video for Black Hole, built with Remotion.

scripts.studio: npm run audio && npm run voice && remotion studio
scripts.render: npm run audio && npm run voice && remotion render Launch out/blackhole-launch-16x9.mp4
scripts.render:square: npm run audio && npm run voice && remotion render LaunchSquare out/blackhole-launch-1x1.mp4
scripts.render:vertical: npm run audio && npm run voice && remotion render LaunchVertical out/blackhole-launch-4x5.mp4
scripts.render:all: npm run render && npm run render:square && npm run render:vertical
